Bulletin No: 01 LRA/26/05/12/01
COLOR: Amber
Advisory for Heavy Rain
Issued by the Natural Hazards Early Warning Centre
Issued at 03.30 p.m. on 12 May 2026 valid for the period until 03.30 p.m. 13 May 2026
For Western, Sabaragamuwa, North-western, North-central provinces and
Trincomalee, Galle and Matara districts
PLEASE BE PREPARED!
Due to the influence of the low-
pressure area in the vicinity of Sri Lanka,
Heavy falls above 100 mm with strong
lightning are likely at some places in
Western, Sabaragamuwa, North-
western and North-central provinces
and in Trincomalee, Galle and Matara
districts.
Therefore, general public is advised to
take adequate precautions to minimize
damages caused by heavy rain, strong
winds and lightning during
thundershowers.
